title: Daily briefing: The sky as you’ve never seen it — the month’s best science images
title_zh: 每日简报：全新视角的天空——本月最佳科学图像
abstract: Coloured stripes across the sky and a crab caught in jellyfish tentacles are among this month’s sharpest science shots. Plus, a ‘speech clock’ could determine how fast you’re ageing and how invasive plant species are displacing farmers in Africa.
abstract_zh: 彩色条纹横跨天空，蟹被困在水母触手中，都是本月最清晰的科学照片。此外，‘语速计’可测定你的衰老速度，侵入性植物种类正在非洲取代农民的土地。
